title: Perfomance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**

INSBIX is a global services company providing IT services, digital marketing, branding, website development, e-commerce solutions, Shopify development, and comprehensive marketing solutions to diverse clients. The organization focuses on best practices and thought leadership to help businesses overcome industry challenges and thrive. INSBIX closely follows emerging trends and insights, enabling clients to reinvent their business ecosystems and build effective digital roadmaps. The company delivers tailor-made solutions for individuals and large organizations alike, supported by continuous research on the online landscape. Its in-house team of skilled professionals collaborates to plan, create, and execute solutions aligned with each client’s vision. 

**Role Description**

The Performance Marketer role at INSBIX is a full-time, on-site position based in Palghat. The individual in this role will plan, launch, and optimize performance-driven digital campaigns across channels such as search, social media, and display advertising. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing campaign budgets, tracking key performance metrics, conducting A/B tests, and adjusting strategies to improve ROI and conversion rates. The Performance Marketer will collaborate with content, design, and development teams to align messaging, landing pages, and user journeys with campaign goals. The role also involves reporting insights to stakeholders, identifying growth opportunities, and staying updated on digital marketing trends and tools.

Qualifications

* Strong performance marketing skills, including paid search, paid social, display advertising, and remarketing.
* Experience with analytics and tracking tools, such as Google Analytics, ad platform dashboards, conversion tracking, and A/B testing tools.
* Solid understanding of digital marketing fundamentals, including campaign strategy, audience segmentation, funnel optimization, and basic SEO principles.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams, coordinate with content and design stakeholders, and align campaigns with broader branding and marketing goals.
* Proficiency in using spreadsheets or BI tools to analyze data, interpret metrics, and prepare clear performance reports.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Previous experience in performance marketing, preferably in an agency or multi-client environment, is an advantage.

title: Sr Supply Chain Executive
description:
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr Supply Chain Executive to join our dynamic team at Unilever Plc. This role is crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery of products to our global customers.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Develop and implement supply chain strategies to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels.
* Manage end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, procurement, logistics, warehousing, and inventory management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., manufacturing, marketing, sales) to align supply chain activities with business objectives.
* Lead and mentor a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including supplier disruptions, transportation issues, and inventory obsolescence.
* Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities for optimization, and areas for improvement.
* Negotiate contracts with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure favorable terms and conditions.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, quality standards, and company policies throughout the supply chain.
* Drive the adoption of new technologies and best practices in supply chain management.
* Prepare and present regular reports on supply chain performance to senior management.

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, preferably within the FMCG sector.
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex supply chain operations and achieving measurable results.
* Strong understanding of supply chain principles, methodologies, and best practices (e.g., S&OP, Lean, Six Sigma).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.
* Proficiency in supply chain planning software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, JDA) and advanced Excel skills.
* Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with experience in mentoring and developing staff.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, capable of building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and innovation in supply chain processes.

title: Threat Hunter
description:
**Role Description**
Role Summary We are looking for a Threat Hunter to join our Cyber Security team and proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate advanced threats targeting the bank's IT and digital banking infrastructure. The candidate will use FortiRecon for external attack surface and digital risk monitoring, and interpret threat hunting reports and vulnerability advisories to drive proactive hunts using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel, in line with RBI cybersecurity guidelines and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting across endpoints, network, cloud, and core banking-adjacent systems using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel. Monitor and act on intelligence from FortiRecon (external attack surface management, brand/phishing protection, digital risk monitoring) to identify exposure relevant to a financial services target profile. Interpret threat intelligence reports, vulnerability advisories (CVE bulletins, OEM/vendor advisories), and sector-specific s (CERT-In, RBI/IDRBT, FS-ISAC) to build hunting hypotheses and prioritize action. Develop hunting playbooks, KQL/SPL queries, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, with emphasis on threats relevant to banking (phishing, credential theft, fraud-linked malware, ATM/payment switch threats, insider risk). Correlate findings across EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs to validate threats and hand off confirmed incidents to the Incident Response team. Support timely reporting/escalation in line with CERT-In incident reporting timelines and internal regulatory obligations. Collaborate with Vulnerability Management, SOC, and IT teams to close detection and patching gaps surfaced during hunts. Maintain documentation of hunting methodology, findings, and detection coverage improvements for internal and regulatory audits (RBI IS Audit, VAPT reviews). Stay current on threat actor campaigns and TTPs targeting Indian financial institutions. Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years in a Threat Intelligence/Threat Hunting role, ideally within BFSI or a regulated industry. Hands-on experience with FortiRecon or a similar EASM/Digital Risk Protection platform. Strong proficiency in Splunk (SPL) and Microsoft Sentinel (KQL, analytics rules, workbooks). Ability to read and act on vulnerability advisories (CVSS scoring, exploitability, patch prioritization) and threat intel reports. Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and its application to hunt hypotheses. Familiarity with EDR tools (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, etc.). Understanding of Windows/Linux internals, network protocols, and cloud security (Azure/AWS). Awareness of RBI Cyber Security Framework for Banks, CERT-In guidelines, and PCI-DSS (a plus). Certifications: GCTI, GCFA, CEH, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC-200, or equivalent. Scripting skills (Python/PowerShell) for hunt automation. Prior experience in a bank, NBFC, or fintech SOC environment. Exposure to fraud/payment security use cases.
  
  
**Skills**
Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Splunk, Cloud Security, CrowdStrike, Incident Response, PowerShell

title: Operations Team Lead
description:
Job Description: Operations Team Lead

**Company:**
Lumina Consulting

**Location:**
Kerala, India

**Job Type:**
Full-time | Hybrid

Company Description

Lumina Consulting supports a UK-based client specialising in the wholesale and distribution of branded products sourced from across the world, with a strong focus on beauty, cosmetics, haircare, personal care, hygiene, and perfumery.

Established in 2017, the client initially operated as a retailer and has since expanded into the B2B wholesale and distribution sector. The business manages an extensive product portfolio, with more than 100,000 SKUs in its inventory, and distributes selected European brands within the UK market.

The company is committed to operational excellence, product authenticity, customer satisfaction, and building efficient, scalable business processes across its retail and wholesale operations.

Role Description

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on, and results-driven
**Operations Team Lead**
to oversee daily business operations and lead a team responsible for e-commerce operations, wholesale order processing, inventory management, and customer service.

This full-time hybrid role is based in Kerala, India, combining on-site responsibilities with some work-from-home flexibility.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining accurate inventory records, managing online product listings, coordinating order fulfilment, and ensuring that customer orders are processed and dispatched on time.

The role requires a strong understanding of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon, alongside experience in wholesale operations, inventory control, and people management. The ideal candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of operational challenges, identifying process improvements, and ensuring that the team consistently meets its performance targets.

Key Responsibilities1. E-commerce Operations

* Oversee day-to-day operations across e-commerce marketplaces and online sales channels.
* Manage Amazon inventory, product listings, stock availability, pricing updates, and order fulfilment processes.
* Coordinate product listing creation, content updates, SKU mapping, EAN/barcode verification, and product data accuracy.
* Monitor marketplace performance, operational metrics, account health, and order processing standards.
* Ensure stock levels and product information remain accurate across all relevant sales channels.
* Identify and resolve listing errors, stock discrepancies, order issues, and other marketplace-related operational problems.

2. Wholesale Operations and Order Management

* Supervise B2B wholesale order processing, customer account requirements, and order fulfilment.
* Coordinate with sales and customer service teams to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
* Monitor outstanding orders, supplier availability, delivery schedules, and dispatch timelines.
* Support wholesale customer enquiries, order updates, and operational escalations.
* Ensure wholesale orders meet agreed service levels and customer expectations.

3. Inventory and Warehouse Coordination

* Maintain accurate inventory records across ERP, inventory management systems, and e-commerce platforms.
* Monitor stock movements, discrepancies, incoming deliveries, and outgoing shipments.
* Coordinate with warehouse and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure appropriate stock control procedures are followed, including SKU, EAN, barcode, expiry-date, and product-condition checks where applicable.

4. Team Leadership and Performance Management

* Lead, supervise, and coach team members to achieve operational objectives.
* Allocate tasks, establish priorities, monitor productivity, and ensure accountability.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and training.
* Encourage teamwork, effective communication, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Address operational errors, delays, and performance issues promptly and professionally.

5. Customer Service and Service-Level Management

* Ensure customer enquiries and complaints are handled professionally and within agreed response times.
* Monitor order accuracy, dispatch performance, delivery issues, and customer satisfaction.
* Resolve escalated operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

6. Reporting and Process Improvement

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including order processing time, inventory accuracy, dispatch performance, listing accuracy, and team productivity.
* Prepare regular operational reports and highlight risks, delays, and areas requiring management attention.
* Analyse operational data to identify inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve consistency and scalability.
* Work closely with sales, technology, logistics, and senior management to support business growth.

Qualifications and Required Skills

* Proven experience in e-commerce operations, preferably with hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, product listings, SKU management, and order processing.
* Experience in wholesale, distribution, retail, or FMCG operations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and manage a team effectively.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in customer service, order escalations, and maintaining high service standards.
* Ability to analyse operational data, monitor KPIs, and prepare performance reports.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including data analysis, filtering, sorting, and reporting.
* Experience with ERP, warehouse management, or inventory management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented approach to work.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and make sound operational decisions.
* A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with Amazon, eBay, Shopify, or other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Familiarity with B2B wholesale platforms and high-volume order processing.
* Experience coordinating with third-party logistics (3PL) providers.
* Knowledge of beauty, cosmetics, personal care, haircare, or perfumery products.
* Experience supporting UK-based businesses or working with international teams.
* Familiarity with inventory systems such as Odoo or similar ERP platforms.

Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate will be a dependable and confident leader who combines strong execution skills with a commercial mindset.

They should demonstrate integrity, ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to teamwork. They must be willing to get involved in day-to-day operational tasks while also developing better processes and helping the business scale.

**The objective of this role is simple: build a disciplined, efficient, and accountable operations team that delivers accurate orders, maintains reliable inventory, supports wholesale growth, and consistently meets customer expectations.**

title: Junior Data Analyst (0-2 Years Experience) or Mid-level Data Analyst (2-5 Years Experience) | Palakkad, Kerala | On-Site
description:
**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our team at Stattr in Palakkad, Kerala. This is an on-site, full-time opportunity for individuals who enjoy working with Python, data, APIs, databases, web scraping, and quantitative modeling to solve real-world problems. Whether you’re an early-career developer looking to build your skills or an experienced developer ready to take on more ownership, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll work on building quantitative models, prototyping ideas, developing data pipelines, setting up APIs and databases, and collaborating with our European team.

**﻿
Position Details**

* Location: Palakkad, Kerala (On-Site Only)
* Job Type: Full-Time
* Experience: Junior Data Analyst: 0-2 Years | Senior Data Analyst: 2-5 Years
* Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science
* Working Days: Tuesday-Saturday
* Working Hours: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM
* Compensation: Junior Data Analyst: ₹26,000 per month | Senior Data Analyst: Up to ₹40,000 per month

**Key Responsibilities**

*Qualitative Modelling and Optimization:*

* Develop and maintain qualitative models and methods for operational optimization, asset valuation, risk assessment and long term hedging under complex technical and commercial constraints
* Analyze how asset values and performance respond to changes in power, gas, wind and other market drivers

*Model Implementation and decision support:*

* Set up APIs and databases for model input/output and market data. Perform web scraping to integrate third-party and alternative data sources.
* Develop and maintain reliable analytical workflows and tools using market data, forecasts and asset information.
* Rapidly prototype potential model ideas into functional tools.
* Refactor early-stage or exploratory research code into robust, scalable systems.
* Convert model results into clear practical outputs for portfolio managers and trading teams.
* Adjust models and recommendations as market conditions, asset constraints and business requirements
* Create data visualizations and dashboards to support analysis and decision-making.

*Model Valuation and performance analysis:*

* Evaluate model outputs against actual asset and portfolio performance.
* Analyze effectiveness of strategies and identify main drivers of results.
* Investigate deviations between expected and realized outcomes and recommend improvements
* Clean up and structure existing codebases.
* Build and maintain resilient data pipelines.
* Comfortable working with evolving codebases and improving them for production use.
* Collaborate across time zones with the onshore European team.
* Participate in regular team reviews, planning sessions, and brainstorming discussions.

**Required Skills**

* Strong Python skills, including experience with Pandas, NumPy, FastAPI
* Experience working with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
* Familiarity with web scraping tools such as BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Selenium
* Ability to create effective data visualizations and dashboards.
* Experience with Git, Docker, REST APIs, Basic CI/CD
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

**Experience Expectations**

*Junior Data Analyst (0-2 Years)*

* 0-2 years of experience in a development-focused role.
* Strong coding fundamentals and willingness to learn.
* Eager to experiment, learn quickly, and contribute from day one.
* Ability to work collaboratively and adapt to new technologies.

*Senior Data Analyst (2-5 Years)*

* 2-5 years of experience in a development-focused role.
* Proven ability to design, build, and maintain production-quality solutions.
* Experience taking ownership of technical implementations and delivering independently.
* Comfortable mentoring junior team members and contributing to technical decision-making.
* Strong understanding of software engineering best practices and scalable system design.

**Nice to Have**

* Master’s Degree.
* Experience with financial modelling building and analysis
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services such as Data Factory, Functions, Blob Storage, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience working with web APIs.
* Exposure to quantitative modeling workflows.
* Understanding of statistical concepts and their practical applications.
* Experience with Machine Learning algorithms.

**What We Offer**

* An on-site team that encourages openness, continuous improvement, and shared learning.
* The opportunity to work for a European company and solve real-world problems with measurable outcomes.
* A supportive environment that fosters technical growth, ownership, and initiative.
* Additional pay for weekends.
* A challenging, high-impact role in a growing, innovation-driven company.

**Our Team Values**

* Open Communication – We prioritize honesty, feedback, and healthy discussions.
* Shared Growth – We mentor each other and celebrate personal and team development.
* Technical Excellence – We value clean code, critical thinking, and data-driven decisions.
* Ownership and Accountability – We take responsibility for our work and support one another through challenges.

**About Stattr**

Stattr is a small analytical startup where innovation, technology, and critical thinking drive top-notch solutions for our clients. We foster a collaborative, supportive, and growth-oriented work environment where learning, ownership, and technical excellence are valued every day.

title: Financial Controller
description:
K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic and herbal wellness brand with a legacy spanning generations, best known for personal care products and now growing into skin and hair care. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're building institutional strength across the organisation, starting with finance.

We're looking for a Finance Controller to build a structured, data-driven finance function from the ground up. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role reporting to the Finance Head, and it sits at the center of how KPNA makes decisions on cost, pricing, and growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

**Financial Closing and MIS**

–  Set up and run a disciplined monthly closing process

–  Standardise reporting so leadership gets consistent, timely visibility into revenue, cost, and profitability

**Costing and Profitability**

–  Build SKU-level costing frameworks and standard costing models

–  Drive variance analysis and profitability insights by product and channel

–  Support pricing and margin decisions with real numbers, not estimates

**Inventory and Working Capital**

–  Strengthen inventory tracking, reconciliation, and ageing analysis

–  Improve control and visibility over working capital

**Finance Operations and Controls**

–  Own the accuracy and integrity of day-to-day financial records

–  Build the processes and controls that don't exist yet, not just maintain the ones that do

**Business Partnering**

–  Work directly with sales, marketing, manufacturing, and supply chain to turn numbers into decisions

–  Support the Finance Head in business reviews and planning

**Team Building**

–  Recruit, train, and grow the finance team as the function scales

–  Build capability and a culture of discipline and ownership within the team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

–  8 to 14 years in finance, ideally in manufacturing or FMCG

–  Strong background in financial reporting, costing, and operational finance

–  Comfortable with financial modelling and finance systems

–  CA or CMA preferred, not mandatory for the right candidate

–  Malayalam or Tamil speaking

**WHY THIS ROLE**

This isn't a maintenance job. KPNA is at a stage where the finance function is being built, not just run, and this role shapes what it becomes. If you want ownership over systems and decision-support rather than routine reporting, this is that role.

**LOCATION**

Thrissur, Kerala (on-site)

title: Odoo Consultant
description:

The company also delivers web and app development, branding, and digital marketing solutions to help organizations succeed in a competitive digital environment.
